description: This file contains extension methods for configuring dependency injection services in an ASP.NET Core application related to the Conduit project. It includes methods for adding core services, JWT authentication, and Serilog logging setup.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods to configure dependency injection, JWT authentication, and logging.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Configures the DI container with MediatR, validation behaviors, AutoMapper, and scoped services for user profiles and security.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Sets up JWT bearer token authentication, including token validation parameters and event handling for token reception.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Configures Serilog as the logging framework, with console sink and log enrichment.
